strings.zh: 臭泥『Gri——mer！
strings.en: Grimer: Gri-mer!

strings.zh: 小磁怪『Mag——nem！
strings.en: Magnemite: Mag-nem!

strings.zh: 雷电球『Vol——torb！
strings.en: Voltorb: Vol-torb!

strings.zh: 三合一磁怪『Mag——net！
strings.en: Magneton: Mag-net!

strings.zh: 顽皮弹『Elec——trode！
strings.en: Electrode: Elec-trode!

strings.zh: 臭臭泥『Muuu——k！
strings.en: Muk: Muuu-k!

strings.zh: 闪电鸟『Zap——dos！
strings.en: Zapdos: Zap-dos!

strings.zh: 这是传说中的精灵闪电鸟！{NEWLINE}要捕捉吗？
strings.en: It’s the legendary Pokémon Zapdos! Try{NEWLINE}to catch it?

strings.zh: 闪电鸟精疲力竭了,{NEWLINE}正式捕捉的好机会！
strings.en: Zapdos is exhausted. Now’s the perfect{NEWLINE}chance to catch it!

strings.zh: {VAR:FF01:200}请放过闪电鸟吧！{VAR:FF01:100}
strings.en: {VAR:FF01:200}Spare Zapdos!{VAR:FF01:100}
strings.notes: SIZE-200% line; shortened from ‘Please spare Zapdos!’ to fit at 2x.

strings.zh: 这座无人发电厂从寸草不生{NEWLINE}到现在生机勃勃,{CLEAR}是口袋妖怪们一点点净化的成果。{CLEAR}对栖息环境要求极高的闪电鸟{CLEAR}能到这里筑巢就是最好的证明。{SCROLL}普通精灵净化环境{NEWLINE}为闪电鸟提供栖息地,{CLEAR}闪电鸟则为这些精灵提供保护,{CLEAR}这是好不容易形成的共生生态,{CLEAR}我们不能去破坏啊！{SCROLL}所以拜托你了,请不要捕捉这只闪电鸟。{SCROLL}要停止捕捉闪电鸟吗？
strings.en: This abandoned power plant went from{NEWLINE}barren wasteland to full of life, bit by{CLEAR}bit, as the Pokémon cleaned it up.{SCROLL}Zapdos only nests where the habitat is{NEWLINE}excellent. The fact that it nests here{CLEAR}is the best proof.{SCROLL}Ordinary Pokémon purify the land and{NEWLINE}give Zapdos a home, and Zapdos{CLEAR}protects them in return.{SCROLL}This balance took so long to form. We{NEWLINE}can’t destroy it!{SCROLL}So please, I’m begging you. Don’t catch{NEWLINE}this Zapdos.{SCROLL}Stop trying to catch Zapdos?

strings.zh: 谢谢你能放下训练家对精灵的执着,{NEWLINE}来保护这好不容易恢复的生态。{CLEAR}作为补偿,请你收下这个。
strings.en: Thank you for setting aside a Trainer’s{NEWLINE}drive to catch it, and protecting this{CLEAR}hard-won ecosystem.{SCROLL}Please accept this to make up for it.

strings.zh: 再次谢谢你的高抬贵手,{NEWLINE}希望人们永远不要忘记{CLEAR}保护环境对我们的重要意义。
strings.en: Thank you again for your mercy. I hope{NEWLINE}people never forget how much{CLEAR}protecting the environment matters to{CLEAR}us all.

strings.zh: 请不要这样说,{NEWLINE}即使作为训练家做到了天下无敌,{CLEAR}一旦失去了我们赖以生存的环境,{CLEAR}都将变得毫无意义。{SCROLL}我真的不能看眼睁睁地{NEWLINE}看你破坏这里的生态,{CLEAR}所以拜托你了,{CLEAR}请不要捕捉这只闪电鸟。{SCROLL}要停止捕捉闪电鸟吗？
strings.en: Please don’t say that. Even if you{NEWLINE}became the strongest Trainer in the{CLEAR}world, it would all be meaningless once{CLEAR}we lose the environment we depend on.{SCROLL}I really can’t just stand by and watch{NEWLINE}you destroy this ecosystem.{SCROLL}So please, I’m begging you. Don’t catch{NEWLINE}this Zapdos.{SCROLL}Stop trying to catch Zapdos?

strings.zh: 电力有限,价高者得。{NEWLINE}——火箭动力发电厂
strings.en: Power is limited. Highest bidder wins.{NEWLINE}-Rocket Power Plant

strings.zh: 你在发电厂越努力,{NEWLINE}这个世界就越光明。{CLEAR}——火箭动力发电厂
strings.en: The harder you work at the plant,{NEWLINE}the brighter the world becomes.{CLEAR}-Rocket Power Plant
strings.notes: | RV052: omission: ‘在发电厂’ and the more-X-more-Y structure restored

strings.zh: 所长『那个谁！谢谢！{NEWLINE}这个是我的谢礼,{CLEAR}请收下这个技能机！{NEWLINE}
strings.en: Manager: Hey, you! Thank you! Here’s{NEWLINE}my thanks. Please take this TM!{NEWLINE}

strings.zh: 所长『技能机５７是{NEWLINE}必杀！充电光线！{SCROLL}哔哔哔哔~{NEWLINE}发射后不仅能造成伤害,{CLEAR}有时我方还能提升特攻哦！
strings.en: Manager: TM57 is Charge Beam, my{NEWLINE}specialty!{SCROLL}Bzzzzt! It deals damage, and sometimes{NEWLINE}it raises your Sp. Atk too!

strings.zh: 职员的心得{SCROLL}１　电力非无限{NEWLINE}２　请尽量节约{CLEAR}３　相互打招呼{CLEAR}４　要谨慎小心{CLEAR}５　穿橡胶底鞋{CLEAR}６　所长了不起
strings.en: Staff Mottos:{SCROLL}1. Electricity is not infinite.{NEWLINE}2. Conserve wherever possible.{CLEAR}3. Greet one another.{CLEAR}4. Always be careful.{CLEAR}5. Wear shoes with rubber soles.{CLEAR}6. The Manager is awesome.

strings.zh: 正确用电{NEWLINE}带给你明亮、舒适的生活！{SCROLL}　　　　……关东电力
strings.en: Use electricity wisely{NEWLINE}for a bright and pleasant life.{CLEAR}Kanto Power Plant

strings.zh: 这里原来是那个常磐市馆主{NEWLINE}名下的私人发电所,{CLEAR}后来因污染而被精灵联盟关停。{CLEAR}不过依现在的情况来看,{CLEAR}这里已经完全看不到污染的痕迹了。{SCROLL}根据我的调查发现,{NEWLINE}是臭泥们以污染物为食{CLEAR}将这里的环境给净化了。{SCROLL}很神奇吧？明明看起来脏兮兮的、{NEWLINE}大家都不怎么喜欢的口袋妖怪{CLEAR}却可以净化环境。
strings.en: This used to be a private power plant{NEWLINE}owned by that Viridian City Gym Leader.{SCROLL}It was later shut down by the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League because of pollution.{SCROLL}But from the look of things now,{NEWLINE}there’s no trace of pollution left here{CLEAR}at all.{SCROLL}According to my survey, the Grimer ate{NEWLINE}the pollutants and cleaned up the{CLEAR}environment here.{SCROLL}Amazing, right? Pokémon that look{NEWLINE}dirty, that nobody much likes, can{CLEAR}actually purify the environment.

strings.zh: 保护环境人人有责,{NEWLINE}切不可因为一时的贪念{CLEAR}而破坏我们赖以生存的家园。
strings.en: Protecting the environment is{NEWLINE}everyone’s job.{SCROLL}Never let a moment of greed destroy{NEWLINE}the home we all depend on.

strings.zh: 您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}大人吧？{NEWLINE}刚刚有几个穿着火箭队服的人{CLEAR}进入了无人发电所深处。{SCROLL}我担心他们会对里面{NEWLINE}的闪电鸟图谋不轨,{CLEAR}拜托您进去看一下吧！
strings.en: You’re the League Champion, {VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}aren’t you?{SCROLL}Some people in Team Rocket uniforms{NEWLINE}just went deep into the Power Plant.{SCROLL}I’m worried they’re up to something{NEWLINE}with the Zapdos in there. Please, go in{CLEAR}and take a look!
strings.notes: #22–#48: post-game (player is Champion): Lawrence catches Zapdos with an upgraded special Ball, next target Moltres on Cinnabar Island.

strings.zh: 闪电鸟被火箭队抓走了吗？{NEWLINE}那种坏人怎么配做闪电鸟的主人呢,{CLEAR}拜托冠军大人把闪电鸟救回来吧！
strings.en: Did Team Rocket take Zapdos? Crooks{NEWLINE}like that don’t deserve to own Zapdos.{CLEAR}Please, Champion, bring Zapdos back!

strings.zh: 火箭队被消灭以后,{NEWLINE}闪电鸟自己飞回了无人发电所。{CLEAR}为了避免闪电鸟的力量再被坏人使用,{CLEAR}请冠军大人收服闪电鸟吧！
strings.en: After Team Rocket was wiped out,{NEWLINE}Zapdos flew back to the Power Plant on{CLEAR}its own.{SCROLL}So that crooks can never use its power{NEWLINE}again, please, Champion, catch Zapdos!

strings.zh: 只有冠军大人这样的训练家,{NEWLINE}才配得上闪电鸟。
strings.en: Only a Trainer like you, Champion, is{NEWLINE}worthy of Zapdos.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『真不愧是传说中的闪电鸟,{NEWLINE}浑身上下都散发着强大的能量。{CLEAR}不过你现在马上就要成为{CLEAR}我们火箭队的囊中之物了。
strings.en: Lawrence: The legendary Zapdos. Truly{NEWLINE}impressive. Mighty energy radiates from{CLEAR}every inch of it.{SCROLL}But very soon, you’ll be in Team{NEWLINE}Rocket’s pocket.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『住手！离闪电鸟远点！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Stop! Get away from Zapdos!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『啊呀呀,这不是联盟冠军吗？{NEWLINE}你也是来抓闪电鸟的吗？
strings.en: Lawrence: Oh my, if it isn’t the League{NEWLINE}Champion. Have you come to catch{CLEAR}Zapdos too?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我是来阻止你们的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ve come to stop you!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『自己不抓也不让别人去抓,{NEWLINE}你们这些精灵联盟的人可真够坏的。
strings.en: Lawrence: You won’t catch it, and you{NEWLINE}won’t let anyone else catch it either.{SCROLL}You Pokémon League people are really{NEWLINE}rotten.
strings.notes: tone review: 真够坏的 is an open insult ('really rotten'), kept (D-0627)

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『像你们这种人{NEWLINE}根本不配收服精灵,{CLEAR}不配成为训练家！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: People like you have no right{NEWLINE}to catch Pokémon. You don’t deserve to{CLEAR}be Trainers!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『配不配是由实力说了算的,{NEWLINE}可不是你那脆弱不堪的道德感。
strings.en: Lawrence: Who deserves what is decided{NEWLINE}by strength, not by your flimsy sense{CLEAR}of morals.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好啊,那我就用实力阻止你们！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Fine! Then I’ll stop you with{NEWLINE}strength!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『你们给我挡住这家伙,{NEWLINE}我马上做收服闪电鸟的准备。
strings.en: Lawrence: Hold this one off. I’ll get{NEWLINE}ready to catch Zapdos.

strings.zh: 是！
strings.en: Yes, sir!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 绝不会让你靠近吉尔露太大人的。
strings.en: We won’t let you anywhere near Master{NEWLINE}Lawrence.

strings.zh: 你准备受死吧。
strings.en: Prepare to die.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不能战斗了就赶紧让开,{NEWLINE}不要挡路！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If you can’t battle anymore,{NEWLINE}get out of my way!

strings.zh: 你休……想……
strings.en: Don’t... you... dare...

strings.zh: 就算是死……也要……
strings.en: Even if... it kills me...

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『好了,{NEWLINE}特殊精灵球准备完毕,{CLEAR}去吧！
strings.en: Lawrence: There. The special Poké Ball{NEWLINE}is ready. Go!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『跟烧焦塔那时候一样,{NEWLINE}一球就收服了……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Just like at the Burned{NEWLINE}Tower... Caught with a single Ball...

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哈哈没错,{NEWLINE}这是烧焦塔捕捉三圣兽时{CLEAR}所用精灵球的改良版。{CLEAR}只要投出这种球,{CLEAR}就算是传说中的精灵也能轻松抓住！
strings.en: Lawrence: Ha ha, exactly. It’s an{NEWLINE}improved version of the Ball we used to{CLEAR}catch the three legendary beasts at{CLEAR}the Burned Tower.{SCROLL}Throw one of these, and even a{NEWLINE}legendary Pokémon is easy to catch!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『居然制造了这种东西……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You actually made something{NEWLINE}like that...

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『我还是第一次在你脸上{NEWLINE}看到这么难看的表情。{CLEAR}等我们捉到更多传说中的精灵后,{CLEAR}你的表情会更难看吧？哈哈哈哈！
strings.en: Lawrence: This is the first time I’ve{NEWLINE}seen such an ugly look on your face.{SCROLL}Once we’ve caught more legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon, I bet you’ll look even worse!{CLEAR}Ha ha ha ha!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我不会让你们带走闪电鸟的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I won’t let you take Zapdos!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『想用暴力阻止我？{NEWLINE}傻子才会跟你缠斗呢。{CLEAR}接下来我们{VAR:FF00:1}要去红莲岛捕捉火焰鸟了{VAR:FF00:0},{CLEAR}你有本事就来阻止试试啊。{SCROLL}吉尔露太『穿洞绳！
strings.en: Lawrence: Stop me with force? Only a{NEWLINE}fool would brawl with you.{SCROLL}Next, we’re off to {VAR:FF00:1}catch Moltres on{NEWLINE}Cinnabar Island{VAR:FF00:0}. Stop us if you can.{SCROLL}Lawrence: Escape Rope!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『下一个目标是{NEWLINE}{VAR:FF00:1}红莲岛的火焰鸟{VAR:FF00:0}吗？{CLEAR}必须马上去阻止他们才行！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Their next target is {VAR:FF00:1}Moltres{NEWLINE}on Cinnabar Island{VAR:FF00:0}? I have to go stop{CLEAR}them right away!
